info.text:
Your seatmate paid $150. You paid $400. Same seat.

Airlines split each cabin into fare buckets. When the cheap one sells out, a pricier one opens.
In 2025, Delta's premium tickets brought in $22.1B vs $23.4B for main cabin, and Amex paid Delta $8.2B.
The average US domestic fare, inflation-adjusted, fell from $618 in 1995 to $387 in 2025.

Sources: Delta 2025 Form 10-K, BTS (Apr 2026).
News and education, not financial advice.
